candidates.why: 0003's incumbent verbatim (run_study.py make_model 'hgb', run_carve.py's explicit last-10% validation split); every other parameter at the sklearn 1.9.0 default
horizon only: was the incumbent stopped early by patience 10 on a 26-class validation loss that moves by thousandths? (at 2048 it fired after 22 iterations at 100000 rows and 38 at 500000)
lower rate, longer horizon: the standard boosting trade; the cap of 300 bounds the worst-case cost
capacity plus regularisation plus a lower rate together: 800000 rows x 26 classes supports bigger trees than 63 leaves, and the deep-tree baseline gained 0.1459 -> 0.1812 from depth 8 to 16 at 4096
the wide-tree end with the leaf-size regulariser that matters for 26-way splits on noisy histogram columns; run_study.py records that unregularised capacity collapsed the 100k rung once

per-split column subsampling: feature_ablation.json banks that the 555 alignment columns carry little, i.e. about half the 1108-column vector is near-redundant, and subsampling is the cheap decorrelator (new in sklearn 1.4, unavailable to the 0003 pilot)
the low-variance end: small trees with heavy L2; at chance 0.038 and top-1 0.17 the task is signal-starved and a lower-variance learner can beat a higher-capacity one at the same data

cache_identity.X_note: the builder cache's FEATURE array, hashed for the first time here. Every earlier preregistration sealed only y and g of this file, so no gate read a single feature byte of it: the split is a function of y, g and the seed, and every block hash is over row indices. 0021's collision rule is about that array, so the array is now sealed directly and the rule corroborates rather than carries it (0021 pre-freeze review, condition lens, finding H2). Costs about 8 seconds at launch.

fit_corpus_described.convention: n_chunks in fit_corpus is the number of source chunks that CARRY ROWS, which is what the runner measures (1029); 1035 chunks were selected and 6 of them produced no row because every one of their 26 streams fell below the 4096-byte carve floor. The sealed extension corpus uses the same convention (n_chunks 2387 with rows, 2400 built).
fit_corpus_described.selection_rule: every whole 32768-byte chunk of each pinned blob that 0018's sealed selection (n_per_family 300, seed 20260909, recomputed here from tools/pivot/corpus_ext.py) does not use, in blob order, minus every chunk whose bytes hash to a sealed chunk's or to an earlier fit chunk's; no seed of its own

protocol.floors_source: 0021's banked readings on the same 38452 rows under the same recipes fitted on the same fit block (artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096_rerun.json ext_real_top1: floor_majority, floor_stratified, floor_tree3 = D1, real_logistic = L3, floor_feat1 = U3); deep_tree has no 0021 reading and is floored at 0.0, so that head can raise the expanded bar and never lower it
protocol.null_note: the null control permutes the whole fit block's labels with the split's own generator, exactly as 0021 did at the same generator state, so the permuted label array is 0021's and its hash is sealed here
protocol.reference_source: artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096_rerun.json ext_real_top1: real_incumbent (M1), real_model (M4), real_logistic (L3), floor_tree3 (D1), each fitted on this fit block in this order and scored on this scoring set; a searched head that selects its reference recipe reproduces it with its own confirmatory fit

why: the shape of tools/pivot/run_realsearch.py's confirmatory artifact, selection file and scores file, captured from a smoke run of the runner itself so the realsearch4096 mutation gate builds its control from the RUNNER's output shape rather than from the reader's expectations (docs/OPERATING_RULES.md section 4; CORRECTIONS.md 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-17). Values here are the smoke's and are replaced by the gate wherever the run is sealed; the keys, the nesting and the record fields are the fixture. The gate asserts this key set BOTH ways against the control and against the reader, so a runner that grows or drops a field breaks the gate instead of passing it.
